background_image.alt: Stained timber ceiling and log interior

settings.editor:
The details are what people notice: crisp lines on an accent wall, custom colors on a staircase, an even, lasting finish on beams, ceilings and paneling. We take the same care with preparation here as we do on a whole house.

Our background is log and timber, so we know how wood takes stain and clear coats, and how to keep a finish consistent across a room.

• Trim, doors and built-ins
  • Stairs and railings in custom colors
  • Accent walls
  • Staining and clear finishes on beams, ceilings and paneling
  • Interior log walls
We look at the work in person, talk through colors and products, and give you a clear written estimate with no hidden charges.
Floors, furnishings, fixtures and landscaping are covered. Surfaces are cleaned, repaired and prepped to the manufacturer's specifications.
Premium coatings applied the right way, with enough coats for our dry, high-altitude climate. When we spray, we back-brush for a proper bond.
We clean up every day, then walk the finished job with you before we call it done. Your project lead is your contact the whole way.
